description: This file defines the SignUpViewModel class for the sign-up screen in an Android app, managing form validation errors, navigation events, and conveying validation status through LiveData objects.

classes.name: SignUpViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class that handles user input validation, manages UI state, and triggers navigation for the sign-up screen.

methods.name: onSignUpClicked
methods.description: Validates the email, password, and confirmation password, updates error messages, and navigates to the dashboard if all inputs are valid.

methods.name: onNavigatedToDashboard
methods.description: Resets the navigation event indicator after navigation occurs.
